title: new update inf money and more
features:
Futures list and everything new in this update 
Auto Collect Swords: Loops through equipped swords and automatically adds them to inventory with custom scan delay settings.
​Auto Farm Coins & XP: Automatically fires server remotes to farm coins and experience points with customizable amount and delay settings.
​Smart Mode: Restricts automatic coin and XP farming to active round states to prevent server detection.
​Hitbox Expander: Expands target hitboxes with adjustable sizing, custom transparency, and visual highlights for improved combat targeting.
​WalkSpeed & JumpPower Modifiers: Real-time customization of movement speed and jump height with automatic state persistence upon respawn.
​Anti-AFK Protection: Emulates user input during idle periods to prevent 20-minute disconnection kicks.
​Fluent UI Framework: Modern, acrylic-themed interface with collapsible tabs, sliders, toggles, and notification prompts.
​Information & Credits: Integrated developer details and single-click clipboard copying for community support links
